title: Singing at the piano as a small child and early lessons
summary: Her mother sang in the choir and played piano at home while Humes sang along. Humes sang at church concerts at three or four, had a German teacher and then a lady teacher, and stopped lessons early. John Hammond later advised her against voice study.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Didn't you say that your parents sang in church?
Yeah, my mother used to sing in the Choir. Papa didn't sing, but my mother used to sing in the Choir.
Oh.
She used to play the piano at home and she would teach me, you know? I would sit there and sing and she would play. I guess that's the way I got started singing.
Did she teach you notes?
No, she didn't teach me notes. She just played and I'd sing.
Was there anybody in the church group, anybody that we'd know today? I know that when you went off to school there were people like Jonah (Jones) and Dicky (Wells). But in the church was there
